title: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?
examples: What is the chrysalis made of?
How long does the change take?
Does the butterfly eat when it is a chrysalis?

explain.say: A caterpillar starts its life by eating many green leaves.

draw.text: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: the life cycle of a butterfly. Can you see the eggs and the caterpillar? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.

draw.text: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?

explain.say: Next, the caterpillar makes a special protective shell around itself.
This resting stage inside the shell is called the chrysalis.
Inside the chrysalis, a big change happens called metamorphosis.
After the change, a beautiful butterfly pushes out of the shell.
When you see a butterfly, remember the amazing journey it took to get there.

faq.a: The chrysalis is the hard, protective casing that the caterpillar builds around itself. It keeps it safe while it changes.
Metamorphosis is the big process of changing from one life form to another. It is how the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
asks: What does it mean to change form?

faq.q: How long does the change take?
faq.a: The time it takes can be different depending on the kind of butterfly. Some changes happen quite quickly.

faq.q: Does the caterpillar eat when it is a chrysalis?
faq.a: No, the caterpillar does not eat when it is in the chrysalis. It is resting and changing inside.

faq.q: What is the difference between a chrysalis and a cocoon?
faq.a: A chrysalis is the hard shell for butterflies. A cocoon is usually made by moths and is different.

facts: Caterpillars eat leaves to grow bigger.
The protective shell is called a chrysalis.
The entire change process is called metamorphosis.
Butterflies emerge from the chrysalis to fly.

quiz.say: The stage where the caterpillar rests and changes is the:
quiz.why: The chrysalis is the specific name for the butterfly's protective casing.

wrong.0: The egg is the very first stage, not the resting stage.
wrong.1: The butterfly is the end result, not the resting stage.
wrong.3: A cocoon is usually made by moths, not butterflies.

quiz.say: What is the big word for changing from one life form to another?
quiz.why: Metamorphosis describes the whole process of transformation.

wrong.1: Cycle is a general word for repeating things, not the specific change.
wrong.2: Growth just means getting bigger, not changing form.
wrong.3: Resting only describes what happens, not the process itself.

quiz.say: If a caterpillar turns into a butterfly, it has gone through:
quiz.why: This sequence shows the correct order of the life cycle stages.

wrong.0: The butterfly appears after the chrysalis, not before.
wrong.1: The chrysalis must come between the caterpillar and butterfly.
wrong.3: This goes backward in the life cycle order.
